OTR Open Deck, Reefer & Dry Van Driver: Up to 90 CPM or 30% of Gross

Open deck, reefer and dry van, all miles paid, with extra pay for stops, tarps, detention and layovers. Only 8 months of experience needed.

Apply for this job 2 minutes · No resume needed
PayUp to 90 CPM
Avg weekly$2,200–$3,000+
Home time3 weeks out / 3 days home (or 4 / 4)
Truck2022–2026 Freightliner Cascadia, automatic
Experience8 months CDL-A

Pay rates

Open Deck (flatbed / stepdeck)Up to 90 CPM or 30% of gross
ReeferUp to 82 CPM or 28% of gross
Dry VanUp to 80 CPM or 28% of gross

Pay

  • All miles paid, loaded and empty
  • Weekly direct deposit, 1099 independent contractor
  • Extra stop $50 · Tarp $50
  • Detention $25/hr (3 hr min) · Layover $100/24 hrs

Home time

  • 3 weeks out = 3 days home
  • 4 weeks out = 4 days home (reefer, FL/NA)
  • Passengers 18+ and pets allowed

Truck

  • 2022–2026 Cascadia, automatic, governed 68 mph
  • APU, fridge, inverter, dual dash cameras
  • Samsara ELD, Love's fuel card, I-Pass

Requirements

  • 8+ months CDL-A, valid medical card, FEIN/EIN
  • Max 1 at-fault accident and 3 moving violations in 3 years
  • No SAP, DUI, criminal record or truck abandonment

Extras & costs

  • DOT inspection bonus $100–$500
  • Referral $1,000–$1,500
  • Flights, hotel and bus covered, rental car reimbursed
  • Escrow $1,250 over 5 weeks, occupational insurance $179/month

Pay, routes, equipment and policies are subject to confirmation with the carrier and your recruiter. Average pay is an average, not a guarantee.
